The Rams, led by second-year head coach [[David Cox (basketball)|David Cox]], played their home games at the [[Ryan Center]] in [[Kingston, Rhode Island]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 21–9, 13–5 in [[2019–20 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in third place. Their season ended with the [[2010 Atlantic 10 Conference Baseball Tournament|A-10 tournament]] and all other postseason tournaments were canceled due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic|coronavirus pandemic]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team|Rams]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 18–15, 9–9 in [[2018–19 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in ninth place. They defeated [[2018–19 La Salle Explorers men's basketball team|La Salle]] and [[2018–19 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]] to advance to the semifinals of the [[2019 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] where they lost to [[2018–19 St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball team|St. Bonaventure]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
